edges.reason: setGovernor derives authorization from msg.sender compared to governor
pause is gated by onlyGovernor checking msg.sender
unpause is gated by onlyGovernor checking msg.sender
nextSeason is restricted to the governor via msg.sender
addProtos is restricted to the governor via msg.sender
replaceProto is restricted to the governor via msg.sender
isSenderApprovedFor consumes msg.sender to determine approval
transferFrom authorization depends on msg.sender approval checks
safeTransferFrom authorization depends on msg.sender approval checks
Vault.withdraw is gated by onlyOwner using msg.sender
CappedVault.withdraw is gated by onlyOwner using msg.sender
PresalePack.withdraw is gated by onlyOwner using msg.sender
mint requires msg.sender to be an approved minter
msg.sender is stored as purchaser in PresalePack.purchase
caller-supplied referrer address receives the commission transfer
purchase forwards ETH to attacker-controlled referrer before vault transfer
price local derived from calculatePrice and packCount
calculatePrice output flows into purchase price
callback derives randomness from blockhash which minors/purchasers can influence
blockhash-derived randomness is fed into card component generation
stored randomness result is used as seed in getComponents
purchase id selects the Purchase storage entry in callback
purchase id selects the Purchase storage entry in claim
claim triggers card creation path that decrements mythic limits unchecked
claim performs external calls into integration.createCard during state updates
safeTransferFrom calls onERC721Received on the receiving contract after transfer
receiver callback can re-enter the transfer logic
withdraw sends ETH to owner via transfer
CappedVault.withdraw sends ETH to owner via transfer before updating withdrawn
purchase records a commit block later consumed by callback
callback must set randomness before claim can proceed
season tradability gates whether cards may be transferred
season state is advanced and used for tradability checks
currentSeason is stamped onto new proto cards in _addProto
protoCount increments without overflow checks inside _addProto
mythic limit value is decremented when creating mythic cards
withdraw amount parameter controls the ETH transfer value
packCount parameter drives purchase price and stored purchase record
new governor parameter is assigned to the governor state variable
card components produced in getComponents are minted during claim
rarity derived for a card is resolved to a proto id via getRandomCard

normalization_plan.reason: _gov is the sole input parameter of setGovernor and only affects the governor state variable
amount is the withdrawal parameter consumed by the owner transfer operation
packCount parameterizes the purchase flow and its emitted event
referrer parameter directly determines the recipient of the commission transfer
id parameter indexes the Purchase record resolved during randomness callback
price is a purchase-scoped temporary derived from calculatePrice and packCount
result is the stored randomness reused to generate card details during claim
